meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 它会先自己动手在真实界面上做手动 QA,把结果记成一行行证据表;再只派一个门禁审查员,对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据逐项审计。只有 QA 没有失败行、审查员给出 APPROVE,审查才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发;它会接管整个审查流程,而不是替你写代码。

say.text: 这块功能写完了,帮我做一次门禁审查
say.note: 它会先手动 QA,再派一个审查员。

say.text: 先在真实界面上跑一遍,把 QA 证据和结论给我
say.note: 逐行记录证据和通过与否。

say.text: 照目标、约束和安全要求审查这次改动
say.note: 一个门禁审查员审计整套改动。

howto.what_en: It runs hands-on manual QA on the real surface itself, then launches exactly one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, and QA evidence. It passes only when no QA row fails and the reviewer approves.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work; it then owns the review process.

say_en.text: I've finished this feature—run a gate review on it
say_en.note: Runs manual QA, then one reviewer.

say_en.text: Run real-surface QA first, then give me the evidence and verdict
say_en.note: Records evidence rows and the verdict.

say_en.text: Review this change against the goal, constraints, and security
say_en.note: One gate reviewer audits the whole change.
